findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The repair restores only controls carrying data-focus. The full-page Pull request link (item.js:283–284), breadcrumb, and Plan links and disclosure summary have no such key. When an item update refreshes the page while one of these controls is focused, replaceChildren removes it and this helper never restores focus; Enter then stops navigating. Plan links are generated without a key in markdown.js:31–34. The new browser test covers keyed tabs and part buttons, so it misses these remaining cases.
findings.title: Preserve keyboard focus when live item data refreshes
